name: Hetzner
symbol: Firewall label selectors return all matching Servers
title: Hetzner: Firewall label selectors return all matching Servers (behavior change)
summary: From 1 December 2025, Hetzner Console will display all Servers matching a Firewall label selector, rather than displaying one label selector for each resource

name: Hetzner
symbol: DHE key exchange methods on Load Balancers
title: Hetzner: DHE key exchange methods on Load Balancers removed
summary: From 9 March 2026, Load Balancers will no longer support ephemeral finite-field Diffie–Hellman (DHE) key exchange methods. Elliptic-curve Diffie–Hellman (ECDHE) key exchange methods will continue to be supported
replacement: Elliptic-curve Diffie–Hellman (ECDHE) key exchange methods, which continue to be supported.

name: Hetzner
symbol: Dedicated server targets of Load Balancers
title: Hetzner: Dedicated server targets of Load Balancers removed
summary: We will remove these invalid targets from the Load Balancers on Monday, 20 April 2026
replacement: No action required generally; affected Load Balancers will be contacted by email.

name: Hetzner
symbol: Deleting assigned Primary IPs and Floating IPs
title: Hetzner: Deleting assigned Primary IPs and Floating IPs deprecated
summary: Deleting assigned Primary IPs & Floating IPs is deprecated and will no longer be possible after 1 May 2026. You need to unassign the Primary IP or the Floating IP before being able to delete it
replacement: Unassign the Primary IP or Floating IP before deleting it; update terraform-provider-hcloud to v1.60.0+ or Ansible Collection hetzner.hcloud to v6.7.0+.

name: Hetzner
symbol: Fedora 42 image
title: Hetzner: Fedora 42 image deprecated
summary: The image fedora-42 (IDs 232895138 (x86) & 232895264 (arm)) is deprecated and will no longer be available when creating new servers after 30 June 2026

name: Hetzner
symbol: datacenter property of Servers and Primary IPs
title: Hetzner: datacenter property of Servers and Primary IPs deprecated
summary: We deprecated the datacenter property in the request body and response of Servers and Primary IPs. The removal will happen after 1 July 2026
replacement: The new location property in the request body and response of Servers and Primary IPs, which holds the same data previously under datacenter.location.

name: Hetzner
symbol: OpenSUSE 15 image
title: Hetzner: OpenSUSE 15 image deprecated
summary: The image opensuse-15 (IDs 204457491 (x86) & 204457492 (arm)) is deprecated and will no longer be available when creating new servers after 30 July 2026

name: Hetzner API
symbol: POST /v1/primary_ips
title: Hetzner API: POST /v1/primary_ips (new default)
summary: Primary IPs created without assignee_type return assignee_type = server until 1 August 2026, after this date, its value will be unassigned
replacement: Set assignee_type explicitly when creating Primary IPs; omitting it will return unassigned after the date.

name: Hetzner
symbol: Primary IP assignee_type value when unassigned
title: Hetzner: Primary IP assignee_type value when unassigned (behavior change)
summary: As of 1 Aug. 2026, Primary IP's assignee_type property will return unassigned if the IP is not assigned (assignee_id is null
replacement: assignee_type returns "unassigned" when assignee_id is null, instead of "server"

name: Hetzner
symbol: EC2-compatible routes for Server Metadata
title: Hetzner: EC2-compatible routes for Server Metadata deprecated
summary: This behaviour is now deprecated and will be removed after 1 Aug. 2026. This includes the following schemas: /2009-04-04/meta-data /2009-04-04/meta-data/{key} /2009-04-04/user-data /latest/meta-data /latest/meta-data/{key} /latest/user-data

name: Hetzner
symbol: Omitted TTL when changing an RRSet's TTL
title: Hetzner: Omitted TTL when changing an RRSet's TTL deprecated
summary: When updating the TTL of an RRSet, the value of ttl is no longer optional and must be provided starting on 30 September 2026
replacement: Provide the ttl value explicitly: set it to the desired TTL, or to null to use the Zone's default TTL.

name: Hetzner
symbol: Omitted dns_ptr value for reverse DNS changes
title: Hetzner: Omitted dns_ptr value for reverse DNS changes deprecated
summary: the value of dns_ptr is no longer optional and must be provided starting on 30 September 2026
replacement: Set dns_ptr to the desired domain name, or to null to reset it.

name: Hetzner
symbol: GET /v1/datacenters endpoint
title: Hetzner: GET /v1/datacenters endpoint deprecated
summary: The API endpoints GET /v1/datacenters and GET /v1/datacenters/{id} are now deprecated and will be removed after 1 Oct. 2026

name: Hetzner
symbol: Datacenter server_types and recommendation response fields
title: Hetzner: Datacenter server_types and recommendation response fields deprecated
summary: Starting on 1 October 2026, the fields will be dropped and it is no longer guaranteed that the information in the deprecated fields is accurate
replacement: server_types.locations.recommended replaces recommendation; server_types.locations.available replaces datacenter.server_types.available and datacenter.server_types.available_for_migration; no direct successor for datacenter.server_types.supported

name: Hetzner
symbol: GET /v1/datacenters/{id} endpoint
title: Hetzner: GET /v1/datacenters/{id} endpoint deprecated
summary: The API endpoints GET /v1/datacenters and GET /v1/datacenters/{id} are now deprecated and will be removed after 1 Oct. 2026

name: Hetzner
symbol: Response field deprecated on Images, Server Types and Load Balancer Types endpoints
title: Hetzner: Response field deprecated on Images, Server Types and Load Balancer Types endpoints removed
summary: The response field deprecated of all endpoints that return "Images", "Server Types" and "Load Balancer Types" will be removed on 2 November 2026
replacement: Use the deprecation field instead (for Server Types, the deprecation field of the respective entry in locations)

name: Hetzner
symbol: Debian 11 image debian-11
title: Hetzner: Debian 11 image debian-11 deprecated
summary: The image debian-11 (IDs 45557056 (x86) & 103907373 (arm)) is deprecated and will no longer be available when creating new servers after 30 November 2026

name: Hetzner
symbol: Fedora 43 image (fedora-43)
title: Hetzner: Fedora 43 image (fedora-43) deprecated
summary: The image fedora-43 (IDs 342035601 (x86) & 342035605 (arm)) is deprecated and will no longer be available when creating new servers after 12 February 2027

name: Hetzner
symbol: HTTP Link headers in paginated API responses
title: Hetzner: HTTP Link headers in paginated API responses deprecated
summary: The HTTP Link header specified in the API documentation is considered deprecated from now on and will be removed on 1 April 2027
replacement: Use the meta.pagination object in the response body

name: Hetzner
symbol: Network subnet type server
title: Hetzner: Network subnet type server deprecated
summary: The Network subnet type server is deprecated and will be removed on 15 April 2027. The Network subnet type server is functionally equivalent to the Network subnet type cloud, use cloud instead
replacement: Use the Network subnet type cloud instead

name: Hetzner
symbol: Volume server property in Volume endpoints
title: Hetzner: Volume server property in Volume endpoints deprecated
summary: The old server properties in the same endpoints are now deprecated and will be removed on 27 October 2027. After the removal, requests that create or attach a Volume to a server by using the server property will fail
